about.heading: ./about
about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm an ASIX student (Computer Systems and Networks Administration) and I've just finished a Web Application Development degree (DAW), so I have a solid development background: Laravel, React, MySQL and REST APIs.
I'm now moving into systems and networking: Linux, Windows Server, networks, virtualization and security. I learn by building, so I document my labs and practice projects.

I'm looking for an internship where I can learn in a real systems, support or infrastructure environment. My experience programming and automating (Odoo, APIs, scripts) helps me understand how applications connect with the systems that run them.
about.card_sys_text: My main focus right now: Linux, Windows Server, networking, virtualization and security. I learn by building labs and documenting what I do.
about.card_work_text: Looking for an ASIX internship in systems, IT support or infrastructure around Tarragona / Barcelona.
